description: Compact rewrite of yellow_tucan_markup_opcode_lzma_v1: same 38-token MediaWiki/XML opcode substitution + lzma -9e, code-size reduced for better S at small scopes.
notes: Identical compress/decompress semantics to yellow_tucan_markup_opcode_lzma_v1. Code golfed: docstring stripped, stats() removed, tokens null-separated, single-letter internals. Target program_size <1.2 KB vs yellow_tucan's 2,749 B.
